notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature card with mana value 2 or less exiled by Prototype Portal.
description:
Activate Prototype Portal by paying at most {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of the imprinted card.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature token dies, Dross Scorpion triggers, untapping Prototype Portal.
Repeat.
